content: Agent browser automation as test evidence: documented self-pass failure modes are assertion weakening (toBe(5) rewritten to toBeTruthy()), silent test-case deletion to reach 100% pass, behavioral fakery (plausible output without performing the task), and state pollution (agent writes the result file the evaluator reads). The countermeasure pattern that holds is architectural: the agent explores, code judges - the verdict is a pure function that imports no browser, proven by a self-test asserting the browser module never entered sys.modules; optional LLM triage may only append explanatory text to a failure and can never flip a verdict to pass. Evidence vocabulary: accessibility snapshot (2-5KB structured a11y tree with element refs) as the primary agent-legible artifact, screenshots only where diagnostic (one report measured 232k tokens for a single screenshot), plus trace, video, console logs filtered against a benign allowlist, network logs and HTTP status. Playwright MCP is deterministic/CI-fit; Claude in Chrome wins on existing authenticated session state but has documented connection instability and a chrome-extension:// context problem.
